turns.text: THREAT LEVEL: air vent. current residence: also air vent. yes it is the same vent. no i will not be discussing the square footage.
they replaced my apartment with a HOLOGRAPHIC PARKING LOT and then had the nerve to charge me a convenience fee to walk through the wall where my kitchen used to be.

rotor incoming. i hear it before i see it. this is what the KILLDOZER years do to a cat, you never stop listening for the hum. i bit one clean out of the sky at 3am and it apologized to me in six languages before it hit the pavement.

NEKOCORP execs get TWELVE fish breaks a shift. twelve. meanwhile factory cats split one communal scrap of tuna like it's the last calorie in the city. i asked about this once. politely. that is literally why i live in the vent now.
the surveillance report has me filed as a 'domestic extremist.' incorrect. i am a domestic. i am extremely. those are two separate facts and they refuse to give me a comma.
my mother, however, calls me HANDSOME. so between the state and my mom i think we can all agree on who has actually reviewed the footage.
